content.text: The Tigers can lean on their policy regarding your commission tweet...they are paid when the account is paid in full. In most cases especially now, they won’t be for a year or more now because people have paused making payments due to COVID or they are on a monthly plan that won’t be paid in full until the end of the calendar year. Wings are actually worse than Tigers even. I had accounts paid in full but they never paid me because I left before the GAME OCCURRED, which really makes no sense. The client paid in full but because hockey game X didn’t drop the puck until March, I never got paid.
